approach: Add one route that runs a trivial query against the existing pool and reports the outcome as the response status, so a load balancer can read health without interpreting a body.

steps.description: Register a GET /health route beside the existing search route.
Check the database from the handler with a trivial query through the existing pool, bounded by a short timeout.
Return 200 when the query succeeds and status 503 for an unhealthy service when it does not.

risks: A health check without a timeout hangs behind the same outage it is meant to report.
